cohort: The study included two groups of rhesus macaques: a control group (n=5) and a THC-exposed group (n=5) that received daily THC edibles pre-conception and throughout pregnancy.
finding: Chronic prenatal THC exposure significantly decreased amniotic fluid volume, placental perfusion, and fetal oxygen availability, leading to placental insufficiency, ischemic injury, and alterations in placental transcriptome related to vasculature development and angiogenesis.
gest_age: Serial measurements taken at gestational days 85, 110, 135, and 155; placental collection at G155 (full term is ~G168).
